purpose: Replace unit-only confidence with real authenticated backend and browser evidence for the complete FT-006 boundary.
success_outcome: The local runtime demonstrates truthful authenticated checkout delivery validation and handoff while proving no FT-006 order or payment-provider mutation and no evidence privacy breach.
anti_goals: Do not implement or verify FT-007 order/inventory behavior or FT-009 provider behavior.
Do not use live OAuth/payment/delivery providers, production secrets, or production data.
Do not bypass storefront/backend/auth boundaries with direct database or fake-server acceptance.

forbidden_scope: production data, credentials, tokens, or secrets

success_checks: Real local runtime proves authenticated checkout, option order, 0/500/700 RUB tariffs, field rules, conditional address, optional comment, and card/sbp/sberpay.
Normalization-before-limit and sanitized errors are proven with synthetic values.
422 delivery_method_unavailable recovers by retry or explicit alternative selection without substitution.
Validated snapshot/payment-ID handoff is proven while no order, reservation, payment attempt, or provider request is created.
Evidence is sanitized and cleanup is unconditional.
T3 closure evidence contains semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
evidence_required: Real local backend integration output with synthetic actor and sanitized assertions.
Playwright browser trace/screenshots or equivalent for authenticated checkout and recovery.
No-order/no-payment-provider negative evidence, privacy scan, and cleanup evidence.
Typecheck/build/lint plus T3 semantic, checkpoint, and rollback/recovery evidence.

stop_conditions: Real local runtime cannot exercise authenticated storefront/backend boundaries.
Acceptance requires live provider credentials, production data, or unredacted sensitive evidence.
No-order/no-payment-provider non-mutation cannot be observed credibly.
Cleanup cannot be guaranteed after success or interruption.
Implementation requires changing FT-007/FT-009 contracts or FT-004 auth behavior.
required_handoff: Report changed_files, commands_run, evidence, scope_compliance, and blockers_or_none.
Run /verify and /red-verify before T3 closure and record exact HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present markers.
